name: test-app-gherkin-nightwatch
description: Runs the shared harness-world feature under Nightwatch's Cucumber runner, with @harnessed-ts/gherkin/nightwatch and the nightwatch driver against the served React fixture.

scripts.test: start-server-and-test 'FIXTURE_PORT=5199 pnpm --filter @harnessed-ts/conformance serve:fixture' http://localhost:5199 'nightwatch --config nightwatch.conf.cjs --env chrome'
